interface.event_owner: model-specific dispatcher and fabric derive issue and matched completion events from real executor handshakes

numeric.progress_unit: logical row for embedding PART; logical output column for GEMM PART
numeric.completion: FULL marks valid on successful completion; PART marks valid only after final segment; INPLACE restores valid after successful completion
numeric.failure: failed write clears valid and progress; sticky state_error records malformed event sequences

required_cases: state survives chunk DONE when reset is not asserted
verification.proof_scope: bank completion metadata only; no data bank memory, dispatcher, compute, or board execution
